# FocusCanvas v0.2.3

This patch release makes focus completion strict: a task can only be completed by a focus session after its full planned timer has elapsed.

## Fixed

- Clicking `Finish` early no longer completes the focus session or its linked task.
- Focus completion is rejected at the repository layer until elapsed focus time reaches the planned duration.
- The editor timer disables `Finish` until `00:00`.
- When the timer reaches `00:00`, the existing automatic completion path still records the session, completes the linked task, and updates progress/calendar.
- Cancelling a session remains available for stopping early without completing the task.
